subject: Role classification assessment — L5 manager vs senior IC (Emily Zhao)
messages:
From: Greenleaf Talent <talent@greenleaf.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate recommendation: Emily Zhao — role level suggestion

Hi Vanessa,

Quick intro — Greenleaf here. We have a strong candidate, Emily Zhao, for the Search relevance team (referred by internal hiring manager). Based on the interview loop (IC+TL+Hiring Manager) our recommendation is L5 on the manager track (people manager) given:
- 4+ yrs leading a multi-discipline team of 3-5 engineers (hiring + performance cycles)
- built roadmap & cross-functional partnerships for search relevance product area
- demonstrated promotion-readiness signals in leadership interviews

Alternative: hiring manager mentioned they could consider Senior IC (L5 IC) if org prefers individual contributor. Candidate is open to either, but prefers manager track long-term.

Attached: job description (manager), candidate resume, draft offer sheet.

Next step: please advise level confirmation/comp bands so we can extend.

Thanks,
Alex (Greenleaf)
--
Alex Park
Principal Recruiter, Greenleaf Talent
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Park <talent@greenleaf.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate recommendation: Emily Zhao — role level suggestion

Thanks Alex — sharing with comp and hiring ops for quick alignment. Two things I need to decide before approving manager track:
1) Headcount impact: does this consume a manager HC bucket or an IC bucket? (we have one open manager HC in Search but it is earmarked for a different team)
2) Compensation anchor: what salary/equity band are you proposing for L5 Manager vs L5 Senior IC here?

Laura/Karthik — can you weigh in? This one is time-sensitive (candidate expects an offer by end of week).

Vanessa
VP, Product & Eng, Search
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Alex Park <talent@greenleaf.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate recommendation: Emily Zhao — role level suggestion

Vanessa — quick context from the hiring manager:
- Team currently needs someone to manage two ICs and own recruiting/hiring for that pod immediately (manager onboarded would start hiring cycle this quarter).
- Emily ran hiring at prior company and has concrete interviewer calibration artifacts in loop.
- We believe product/people work for first 6 months will be heavy (onboarding, triage, 1:1s).

Given that, manager track aligns to org needs and reduces risk to delivery. If HC bucket is the blocker, we can swap another open manager HC, but that requires ops signoff.

Attaching the manager job description and the draft offer sheet with suggested comp.

-Marissa
Sr. Eng Manager (Search)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: job_description_L5_manager.docx, emily_zhao_offer_sheet.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate recommendation: Emily Zhao — role level suggestion

Vanessa — quick note from an org design POV: I agree the candidate is capable, but two concerns:
1) Manager headcount is constrained in Search. If we convert an IC bucket to manager now we reduce capacity for IC hiring later this year.
2) Historically we see faster time-to-impact when experienced ICs first anchor the product area and then convert to manager after one cycle.

Recommendation: extend as L5 Senior IC with a clear 9-12 month manager pathway and a documented promotion trigger (Hires>1 + measurable 1:1/feedback metrics). That reduces HC churn risk and keeps immediate IC throughput.

If leadership prefers manager now, I request an explicit HC swap approval and a comms plan.

-Jonas
SVP, Eng Operations
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Park <talent@greenleaf.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate recommendation: Emily Zhao — role level suggestion (comp anchors)

Folks — comp anchors below (total cash / equity — 4yr vesting, standard cliff):
- L5 Senior IC: Base 175k-195k, target bonus 12%, RSU grant 0.3%-0.5% (approx 30k-45k value first year)
- L5 Manager: Base 180k-205k, target bonus 12%, RSU grant 0.4%-0.6% (approx 40k-60k first year)

If we go manager track we should set the offer at top of L5 manager band given hiring market and candidate profile. For IC route, offer at mid-high depending on sign-on. No need for special comp committee escalation for these figures; if we go above 210k base or >0.6% RSU, we escalate.

Karthik
Head of Compensation & Rewards
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Park <talent@greenleaf.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: proceed with L5 manager offer (Emily Zhao)

Team — after weighing org risk and candidate preference, I approve extending an L5 Manager offer to Emily with the following constraints:
- Use manager HC bucket (we will swap HC with Product Ops; Marissa to coordinate)
- Offer anchor: Base $200,000, 12% target bonus, RSU 0.55% (4yr)
- Include a 9-month review checkpoint for impact + calibration; promotion/pipeline to L6 Manager only after documented hires and performance on 1:1s
- DocuSign link below for HR to route.

Alex — please extend the offer today and flag candidate for expedited negotiation. If candidate pushes significantly above the anchor (base >210k or RSU >0.6%), escalate to me.

Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround.

Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Product & Eng, Search
Redwood Inference

Offer link: https://docusign.com/link/XYZ-Offer-EmilyZ
Hiring record: https://hubspot.company/recs/HS-98234
